score_reference: shipped model scores on the training split, in sample

calibration.rule: alert edge per column is max(PSI_ALERT, worst PSI over the in-control batches); a column alerts strictly above its edge; the batch flag is the score past its edge or more alertable columns past theirs than any held-out in-control batch showed

not_alertable.reason: target encodings are computed at each training row's own lagged day, so the training histogram is the encoder's clock, not the population; reported, never alerting
